_comment: PER-ABILITY VFX. Content, not code: adding or restyling an ability's effects must not need an engine or renderer change. Keyed by character, then by ability id. `packages/client/src/ability-vfx.ts` reads this and decides what to draw; the renderer only executes. Colours are duplicated from each character's `magic` block in data/art/<id>.json rather than imported, because that file is an art SOURCE (thesis, build, garment) and does not ship to the browser. `ability-vfx.test.ts` asserts the two agree, so the copy cannot drift.

aegis._thesis: Never warm. A paladin's light is given to him; Aegis forces his. Pale, sickly, effortful.

shield_bash._comment: A cone at range 2. Nothing flies; the door does the work. All of the effect is at the far end.

barrier_pulse._comment: He pushes it out of himself and it lands on someone else — so both ends show, and the near end is the effortful one.

intercept._comment: The blink. He casts, then he is simply somewhere else — see `blink` in animate.ts. A ring at the square he leaves and another where he arrives, so the eye can follow a unit that never crossed the space between.

warding_halo._comment: The ultimate. Bigger and slower than anything else he does, because it is the one time the effort pays off.

wisp._thesis: Every tool is a lie about where she is. One cold plum material at different intensities — decoy, veil and blink all read as the same drifting mauve, never fire, never warm. Slow, weightless, no upward buoyancy.

dagger_flurry._comment: Melee cone — daggers where she stands. Nothing flies; a low plum bloom at the cone and a flick of smoke.

bola._comment: Thrown line: the bola crosses the gap, then a plum snare-bloom and a drift of smoke where it lands (24 + Slow).

blink._comment: The dodge. She casts and is simply elsewhere (see blink in animate.ts). Smoke drifts up where she WAS (the cast throws it) while a ring marks where she arrives, so the eye can follow a unit that never crossed the gap. Same beat as the decoy so the two reads rhyme.

veil_decoy._comment: The vanish + decoy (free action). The fade-out is the signature, and it is a CAST — the smoke drifts (style: drift fires on the cast, not just impacts) as she goes and the decoy is left holding her shape. The one effect a ring could never carry.

shadowstep_strike._comment: The ultimate. Untargetable, then she arrives during Dash and strikes everything within 1 — the one time the misdirection ends in a hit, so it is bigger and slower than the blink. Smoke at the vanish, a burst on arrival.

vex._thesis: The exact mirror of Wisp: where Wisp is cold plum smoke that removes information, Vex is warm amber ordnance that adds it. One hovering armed-mote language repeated across beam, grenade, trap and ult — emissive, precise, warm. She reads LIGHT on a dark board; her light is the amber. (Laser beams for rail_shot and lance_of_dawn, and the trap's floating drone-and-downward-beam, are their own render primitives; the auras and motes here are the shared ordnance glow around them.)

rail_shot._comment: The auto attack: a thin ORANGE LASER lances to the target — a solid beam drawn in her edge amber (tracer: beam), not a streak. A tight amber spark where it lands; near-zero recoil, so the effect is precise, not messy.

frag_grenade._comment: No tracer — the grenade is already sitting on the tile from last turn; it just DETONATES. The explosion is a big amber blast-ring + a hard debris burst centred on the AoE CENTRE (the cast, which carries the disc `area`), not on each victim. See aurasAt/particlesAt AoE-CENTRE.

combat_roll._comment: The dash — nothing flies, she rolls. A low kick of amber dust off the ground where she pushes off; kept small so it reads as movement, not an attack.

overwatch_trap._comment: The free-action mine: on placement an armed amber mote floats UP off the tile (drift, on the cast) and a ring marks the watched square; the hovering drone and its bright downward beam are the render primitive (renderer3d TRAP-DRONE). On ACTIVATION the trap deals damage at the tile, so its `impact` fires a tight bright strike-ring there — the beam coming down.

lance_of_dawn._comment: The ultimate: the ONE time she braces, and a BIG amber laser lances the line — a wide solid beam (tracer: beam at ~3x the rail-shot width). A broad amber scorch and a heavy burst where it lands; the largest effect in her kit.
